_about: Words and timings of the Round2 PS4 tile (tile 0.14+). Plain letters only (A-Z, numbers, ' " - . , ! ?) - anything else is dropped because the TV can't draw it. {crew} = the crew's name. Empty card notes / foot = not drawn (prices on hold, 24 Nov). Times in seconds: ready burst 0.5-5, closing screen 3-20. A wrong file = the tile keeps its own words.
